ASSESSMENT

Diagnosis: Epilepsy, currently on phenobarbital with suboptimal control as evidenced by recent seizures

Differential Diagnosis: Other causes of seizures such as reactive seizures due to metabolic or toxic causes, structural brain disease. Further diagnostics may be needed if seizures persist despite medication adjustments.

PLAN

Treatment Plan and Recommendations: • Added levetiracetam 20 mg/kg PO every 8 hours to current phenobarbital 60 mg PO twice daily
• Recheck phenobarbital level in two weeks

Follow-up: Recheck phenobarbital blood level in two weeks to monitor therapeutic levels and seizure control
